children: DigitalBridge, along with L&G and TD Asset Management, agreed to acquire VodafoneZiggo's passive mobile tower infrastructure from a subsidiary of Ziggo Group.
The business will be combined with Belgium Tower Partners, DigitalBridge's existing tower platform in Belgium.
The combined business will create an independent tower platform across Belgium and the Netherlands with more than 6,600 sites.
The deal is subject to regulatory approvals and expected to close in early 2027.
